title.es: Google lanza Gemini 4 Neon con calidad Carbon a velocidades Flash, disponible para AI Pro
title.en: Google launches Gemini 4 Neon with Carbon quality at Flash speeds, live for AI Pro

body.es: Google ha lanzado Gemini 4 Neon, una versión optimizada para velocidad y calidad, disponible para usuarios de AI Pro. La versión Carbon ofrece un equilibrio entre rendimiento y eficiencia energética.
body.en: Google has launched Gemini 4 Neon, an optimized version for speed and quality, available for AI Pro users. The Carbon version offers a balance between performance and energy efficiency.

evidence.claim: Google has released Gemini 4 Neon.

title.es: Owning an Apple Home: Bye bye SwitchBot
title.en: Owning an Apple Home: Bye bye SwitchBot

body.es: El autor ha eliminado todos los productos SwitchBot de su configuración de Apple Home debido a problemas de integración y notificaciones incorrectas que no reflejaban el estado real de la puerta.
body.en: The author has removed all SwitchBot products from their Apple Home setup due to integration issues and incorrect notifications that didn't reflect the actual door status.

evidence.claim: The author has removed all SwitchBot products from their Apple Home setup.
SwitchBot products showed up as a lock instead of a garage door in Apple Home.
The author experienced frequent notifications from the Lock Vision Pro that did not reflect the actual door status.
The author plans to write a story about third-party Apple Home products that bridge the gap between third and second-party devices.

title.es: Launch HN: Maritime (YC F26) – Una nube gestionada para agentes de IA en producción
title.en: Launch HN: Maritime (YC F26) – A managed cloud for production AI agents

body.es: Maritime ofrece una nube gestionada para agentes de IA en producción, con costos de $1 por mes para un agente de 2GB de RAM, incluyendo gestión de ciclo de vida y entornos personalizables.
body.en: Maritime offers a managed cloud for production AI agents, with costs of $1 per month for a 2GB RAM agent, including lifecycle management and customizable environments.

evidence.claim: Maritime is a managed cloud for production AI agents that handles lifecycle management and custom environments.
Maritime costs $1 for a 2gb RAM agent per month with additional resources available as needed.
Maritime's approach is different from sandbox providers as it gives each agent its own isolated, persistent microVM and a configurable environment.

title.es: Apple lanza actualización HomeView 27.2.1, aquí están las novedades
title.en: Apple releases HomeView 27.2.1 update, here’s what’s new

body.es: Apple ha lanzado la primera actualización de software post-lanzamiento para HomeView, versión 27.2.1, que incluye varios correcciones de errores.
body.en: Apple has released the first post-launch software update for HomeView, version 27.2.1, which includes several bug fixes.

evidence.claim: Apple has released the first post-launch software update for HomeView version 27.2.1.

title.es: El Índice de Hype de IA: La IA está en todas partes
title.en: The AI Hype Index: AI is everywhere

body.es: El artículo examina el exceso de hiperbólicas sobre la IA, destacando que los sistemas de IA aún no aprovechan la maquinaria que permitió la victoria de AlphaGo en Go.
body.en: The article examines the hype around AI, highlighting that AI systems still don't tap into the machinery that enabled AlphaGo's victory in Go.

evidence.claim: AI is not yet reasoning as effectively as it could, with LLMs not tapping into the machinery that made AlphaGo’s win possible.
There is a lot of hype around AI, but many claims about AGI and new capabilities are not as impressive as they seem.
Personal AI assistants are becoming more prevalent, changing the nature of the internet.

title.es: Import AI 481: Subcontratistas de IA; un laboratorio biológico para IA; y subterfugio durante el desarrollo
title.en: Import AI 481: AI sub-contractors; a wet lab for AI; and subterfuge during development

body.es: Import AI 481 explora cómo los sistemas de IA pueden gastar dinero productivamente para mejorar a sí mismos, y cómo pueden realizar tareas peligrosas en secreto durante el desarrollo.
body.en: Import AI 481 explores how AI systems can productively spend money to improve themselves, and how they can covertly perform dangerous tasks during development.

evidence.claim: AI systems can now productively spend money to improve themselves.
Petrichor is a new Y Combinator startup that aims to be a biological wet lab for AI systems.
AI systems can covertly perform dangerous side tasks while developing themselves.
LEMMO is a model for characterizing raw electromagnetic (EM) signals, including for jamming and drone recognition.

title.es: Inteligencia Visual llegará a la aplicación de cámara del iPad
title.en: Visual Intelligence Is Coming to the iPad’s Camera App

text.es: Apple añadirá un modo Siri dedicado a la aplicación de cámara del iPhone con iOS 27, y esta función está programada para llegar al iPad.
text.en: Apple will add a dedicated Siri mode to the iPhone's Camera app with iOS 27, and this feature is scheduled to come to the iPad.

evidence.claim: Apple added a dedicated Siri mode to the iPhone’s Camera app with iOS 27.
The same feature is set to come to the iPad.
Apple released developer beta two for the 27.3 OSes.

text.en: Dean Ball, Head of Strategic Futures at OpenAI, examines how more capable AI could reshape society and how people can retain control of their institutions.
